description: OAuth 2.0 PKCE token exchange handler fails to invalidate authorization codes upon use, allowing token replay attacks.
spec_notes: TokenExchangeHandler must mark AuthCode.used = True and reject replayed codes.

repo_files.auth_code.py:
"""Authorization code payload."""

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Optional


@dataclass
class AuthCode:
    code: str
    client_id: str
    user_id: str
    code_challenge: str
    code_challenge_method: str  # "S256" or "plain"
    used: bool = False

tests.test_oauth_pkce.py:
from auth_code import AuthCode
from exchange import TokenExchangeHandler
from pkce import PKCEVerifier
from token_store import TokenStore


def test_successful_pkce_s256_exchange():
    verifier = "dBjftJeZ4CVP-mB92K27uhbUJU1p1r_wW1gFWFOEjXk"
    # SHA-256 base64url of verifier
    import base64, hashlib
    digest = hashlib.sha256(verifier.encode()).digest()
    challenge = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(digest).decode().rstrip("=")
    code = AuthCode("c1", "client_app", "user_100", challenge, "S256")
    store = TokenStore()
    handler = TokenExchangeHandler(store)
    handler.register_code(code)
    res = handler.exchange("client_app", "c1", verifier)
    assert "access_token" in res
    assert res["token_type"] == "Bearer"


def test_authorization_code_replay_rejected():
    verifier = "plain_verifier_token"
    code = AuthCode("c2", "client_app", "user_200", verifier, "plain")
    store = TokenStore()
    handler = TokenExchangeHandler(store)
    handler.register_code(code)
    # First exchange succeeds
    res1 = handler.exchange("client_app", "c2", verifier)
    assert "access_token" in res1
    # Replay attack with same code must be REJECTED with invalid_grant!
    res2 = handler.exchange("client_app", "c2", verifier)
    assert res2.get("error") == "invalid_grant"


def test_invalid_verifier_mismatch():
    code = AuthCode("c3", "client_app", "user_300", "expected_challenge", "plain")
    store = TokenStore()
    handler = TokenExchangeHandler(store)
    handler.register_code(code)
    res = handler.exchange("client_app", "c3", "wrong_verifier")
    assert res.get("error") == "invalid_grant"
